VIDEO SCRIPT: MY FAMILY FAMILY MEMBERS
Grade: Grade 4 · Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn My Family Family members. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• name family members in the nuclear and extended family
• draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
• explain why it is important to honour parents
• respect family members for harmonious co- existence

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: name family members in the nuclear and extended family
• Model 2: draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
• Model 3: explain why it is important to honour parents
• Model 4: respect family members for harmonious co- existence

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: name family members in the nuclear and extended family
• Practise: draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
• Practise: explain why it is important to honour parents

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for My Family Family members.”
